connector.name: Dockhold
connector.registryDescription: Deploy a GitHub repo to a live HTTPS URL from your AI tool; read logs, set variables, resize apps.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.dockhold.eu over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace eu.dockhold, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>. Create a token in the Dockhold dashboard: Settings -> API tokens (choose read-only or read+deploy). Format: Bearer dh_mcp_...
